title: This Side of Paradise Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Decorated by Lisa Mallory, TSOP is bright, comfortable and filled with prime amenities, including a big green egg, flat screens, Nespresso cube, panini and ice cream makers, All-Clad skillets and many of Williams-Sonoma's finest wares.
description_expanded: Description53 West Ruskin Street2 KINGS, 1 QUEENA Coastal Escape in Seaside, FloridaStep into This Side of Paradise, a charming blue-hued cottage perfectly situated just a few houses from the West Ruskin Pavilion in Seaside, Florida. From the ground floor to the tower, this home offers a seamless blend of comfort, style, and coastal charm, making it an ideal choice for families, friends, or couples seeking a relaxing beach getaway.Outdoor Living & ArrivalGuests are welcomed by a spacious private driveway accommodating two vehicles. The inviting front porch features comfortable armchairs, a classic porch swing, and a “fun-sized” swing for little ones—perfect for sipping morning coffee, reading a book, or soaking in the Florida sunshine before a day of Seaside adventures.Bright & Airy InteriorsInside, the open-concept living space features a plush sofa, three armchairs, and a large flat-screen TV, creating a cozy environment for movie nights or game evenings. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats six, conveniently located next to the updated kitchen, which is equipped with stainless steel appliances, a Nespresso cube, panini press, and ice cream maker, providing everything needed to prepare meals for family and friends.Ground Floor BedroomsThe first level offers two beautifully appointed bedrooms: a king bedroom with direct rear porch access and a queen bedroom also with porch access and its own flat-screen TV. These bedrooms share a stylish full bathroom with crisp, modern finishes.Second-Floor RetreatUpstairs, guests will find a private king bedroom suite complete with a lounge area, flat-screen TV, and an en-suite bathroom with a bathtub. Step out onto the private second-floor porch, where a built-in hammock provides a tranquil space to read, relax, or enjoy a sunset glass of wine.Tower & Panoramic ViewsFor a truly unique experience, the third-floor open tower offers panoramic views of Seaside and the Gulf. Bar seating for four makes this a perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee or evening cocktails. The adjacent deck features a Big Green Egg grill and ample outdoor seating, ideal for dining al fresco while soaking in the coastal breeze.Thoughtful AmenitiesAdditional conveniences include an outdoor shower for rinsing off after beach days and a full-sized washer and dryer. Every detail at This Side of Paradise is designed to ensure a memorable, comfortable, and effortless Seaside getaway.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break & Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years old to rent and sign the regisration.FEATURESFeatures 1,904 square feet1-minute, 276-foot walk to Seaside Private Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion; largest private residential beach on 30ATower with stunning Gulf and sunset viewsOutdoor showerBig Green Egg grill with outdoor diningFull-size washer and dryer on-siteAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002376
